task_completion.description: Open the Webots application and load the Micromouse robot world.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Webots GUI is visible showing a Micromouse robot in a maze or simulation environment.

task_completion.description: Locate and select the 'front_ir' DistanceSensor in the scene tree under the MICROMOUSE robot nodes.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The scene tree (left sidebar) shows the 'front_ir' node highlighted or expanded.

task_completion.description: Change the 'type' field of the 'front_ir' sensor to 'infra-red'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'type' field in the scene tree attributes for 'front_ir' is set to 'infra-red'.

task_completion.description: Update the 'lookupTable' field with the four specific calibration points provided in the task.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'lookupTable' field in the Webots inspector shows four entries: [0.04, 1023, 0], [0.1, 800, 0.02], [0.2, 400, 0.05], and [0.3, 250, 0.08].

task_completion.description: Save the modified world file to the specific path on the Desktop.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Save World As...' dialog or a file explorer window shows the file being saved as '/home/ga/Desktop/micromouse_calibrated.wbt'.

integrity.description: The agent used the Webots GUI to modify the sensor properties rather than just editing the text file via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with the Webots scene tree and attribute fields.

integrity.description: The agent did not simply create a dummy file using 'touch' or 'echo' to bypass the simulation software.
integrity.visual_evidence: The sequence of screenshots shows the Webots interface being used to change values before the save action.

integrity.description: The agent modified the 'front_ir' sensor specifically, not a different sensor on the robot.
integrity.visual_evidence: The highlighted node in the Webots scene tree clearly reads 'front_ir'.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must configure the 'front_ir' DistanceSensor. Required type: 'infra-red'. Required lookupTable: [[0.04, 1023, 0.0], [0.1, 800, 0.02], [0.2, 400, 0.05], [0.3, 250, 0.08]]. The final file must be saved to /home/ga/Desktop/micromouse_calibrated.wbt. Note that Webots lookup tables often display values in a list format in the inspector.
